question: At which exact boundary do common-specialization-compatible interface pairs fail to compile into replay-valid existing-law moves?

decision_table.FAILS_BEFORE_SPECIALIZATION: the earlier compatibility rescue does not reproduce under the compilation pipeline
decision_table.SPECIALIZATION_AGREES_BUT_ITEM_CONSTRUCT: common specialization is semantically coherent but cannot be represented by the current contextual-item constructor
decision_table.ITEMS_CONSTRUCT_BUT_REPLAY_FAILS: the contextual constructor can express the specialized moves but the verifier rejects their derivations
decision_table.ASYMMETRIC_COMPILATION_FAILURE: one side systematically compiles farther than the other, indicating a directional interface/attachment mismatch
decision_table.REPLAYABLE_PAIR_EXISTS: at least one common-specialization witness compiles to a replay-valid pair; return to causal installation
decision_table.MIXED_FAILURE_VERSION_SPACE: multiple incomparable compilation failure modes survive

scientific_rule: This is diagnostic only. Do not introduce or promote a new constructor. Classify the weakest compilation failure supported by the observed stage counts.
